question: 对 8×32 的随机矩阵跑 run_softmax，每行行和与 1 的最大偏差是否小于 1e-5（答 true/false）？
verify:
import sys, pathlib; [sys.path.insert(0, str(p / "src")) for p in (pathlib.Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve().parent.parent, pathlib.Path.cwd()) if (p / "src" / "gkern").is_dir()]
import numpy as np
from gkern.ops import run_softmax
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
x = rng.standard_normal((8, 32)).astype(np.float32)
out = run_softmax(x).output
result = bool(np.abs(out.sum(axis=1) - 1.0).max() < 1e-5)

question: 64×32 @ 32×48、bm=32/bn=16/bk=16 跑 run_matmul，与 numpy 结果的最大绝对误差是否小于 1e-4（答 true/false）？

import sys, pathlib; [sys.path.insert(0, str(p / "src")) for p in (pathlib.Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve().parent.parent, pathlib.Path.cwd()) if (p / "src" / "gkern").is_dir()]
import numpy as np
from gkern.ops import run_matmul
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
